intended_writes: One independent disposable /private/tmp/explorer-http-* fixture tree and private bootstrap files; one fresh Playwright temporary Chrome profile. No production/evidence writes by host.
credential_boundary: Private URLs read inside Node only from exact0600 files. No token/body/raw error/URL output, trace/HAR or screenshot. For race cases a real HTTP response is delayed only in browser memory while abort is intentionally ignored.
cleanup: Close owned context/browser; stop/reap owned service worker; reconcile only recorded descendant identities; audit unchanged stage and fixture bytes/mtimes. Each command owns a separate fixture/process tree.
scope: Current full UI bootstrap/session/copy-link and late response guards; OS launch and native zoom are separate.
